span.p: Are control limits from the PROCESS, not the spec?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Re-derive limits from the process - spec limits are the customer's voice, not the chart's

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Does a run rule trip - point beyond 3-sigma, runs, trends, zone rules?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Common cause - do NOT adjust; tampering with a stable process adds variation

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Assignable special cause found at the time of the signal?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Act on the special cause; containment if product affected; open NCR -> CAPA

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Investigate before reacting; if recurring, escalate to a CAPA on the system
